propositions: 200+ lines of production logic written in YAML run-blocks (staleness classification, alert-ticket state machines) are untestable and unlintable, creating high defect surface.

Classification and alert-lifecycle logic (with branchy decision logic and ${{ }} expression interleaving) should be extracted to scripts/canary_bridge.py with unit tests, while CAS push loops (commit-back and flush) remain in YAML as verbatim-tested exceptions.

The extracted module must preserve existing error handling dispositions per step: alert writes fail loud, dedup finds degrade to not-found on error, bridge-fsck exit-1-with-valid-JSON signals drift not error, and DRY_RUN gating applies both at step and subcommand level.
Anti-rot tests must pin the thin YAML wiring (workflow parses, steps invoke the Python subcommands, flush loop remains byte-identical) to prevent logic regression.
Post-merge operator-attested parity dispatch verifies that the migrated canary produces identical classification and alert behavior to the pre-migration scheduled run.
